policy.allowed: Separate inline administrative Node fs/path/crypto and bounded read-only OS version observations only. Selected candidate/vendor/native bytes never loaded as executable code.
policy.read_protocol: Absolute normalized path; bounded lstat/readlink; record each observed symlink hop and resolved target before any supplier read. For a selected regular file, O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW, whole read, byte hash and stable before/after descriptor/path state. Do not compare historical stat with current. Any missing/error path retained and not silently replaced.
policy.expansion_rule: This first phase observes only named paths. Candidate must have no symlink component for caller use. gtimeout alias may resolve within /opt/homebrew/Cellar/coreutils only; record that exact path before opening its bytes in a later phase. Additional suppliers require an explicitly enumerated extension saved before their reads. No directory scan, recursive walk or broad install search.
policy.historical_boundary: Historical vendor path selections may inform an explicit list, but historical hashes/states do not become current facts.
policy.metadata_decode: Only selected administrative host/version text may be displayed/decoded. Binary vendor/native contents whole-hashed as opaque bytes.

supplier_extensions.selection_rule: Exact preexisting framework_namespace paths only. Historical kinds select read policy, not an assertion of current type. No old byte hash or stat is substituted for current observation.
